title: 21. How do I export an existing survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I export an existing survey.
short_answer: On the 'Surveys' page, search for the survey you want to export. You can either
procedure: click on the 'Export' icon, OR click on the 'Open' icon, and from the 'Overview' page, click on the 'Export' icon.
Your survey, together with all your settings, will be saved to your computer. The file extension of an EUSurvey form file is '.eus'.
